results.title: MASTER INFORMATIQUE – INTELLIGENCE ARTIFICIELLE (IA) – Catalogue des formations d'Avignon Université
results.snippet:
The Artificial Intelligence pathway is attached to the CERI Master's in Computer Science (Avignon University), which includes cross-disciplinary teaching in professional English, information systems management, project management and technology watch. The teaching units (UE) specific to the AI path essentially cover automatic learning (supervised learning, unsupervised learning, reinforcement learning) and data science (data mining, business intelligence, data warehouses). [...] The Master’s in Computer Science programme is taught at the Centre for Teaching and Research in Computer Science (CERI) at the University of Avignon, on the Agroparc business park.  
   
 All LMD IT courses are housed in the modern CERI building, which has 9 IT rooms, 3 network and telecoms rooms, 10 lecture theatres and 2 lecture theatres equipped with audio-video equipment. [...] French :  
 For admission to the first year of the Master’s programme for EU applicants: apply online via the platform My Master’s degree  
 For admission to the first year of a Master’s degree for non-EU applicants: apply via Campus France/Studying in France  
   
   
 English:  
 For admission to Master 1 for applicants from the EU: apply via the My Master’s degree platform.  
 For admission to Master’s Year 1 for non-EU applicants: apply via Campus France/Studying in France.
